title: General-purpose mobile cobots cross 100K production-operation hours by H1 2027
body: Collaborative Robotics' second-generation Proxie debut at Automate 2026 moved general-purpose mobile manipulation from demonstration to a quantified operating record: on-robot task inference with no cloud dependency for core execution, a $5,000-per-month price, and a first-generation track record of 12,627 logged hours, more than 40 million pounds moved, and over 17 million human steps saved across hospitals, manufacturing, and logistics on 16-hour shifts. The prediction is that at least one general-purpose mobile-cobot vendor publishes a cumulative cross-customer fleet operating record exceeding 100,000 production hours, framed as a deployment metric rather than a pilot or demo. The pivot the launch surfaces is that physical-AI vendors are competing on audited hours-in-operation and dollars-of-material-moved instead of show-floor capability clips; once one general-purpose platform anchors marketing on a six-figure fleet-hours number, monthly-subscription pricing turns operating hours into the unit buyers underwrite and rivals are pulled onto the same scoreboard. This is a productized-deployment claim, distinct from a hardware-supply or orchestration-reliability call.

reasoning.because: Cobot's Gen-2 Proxie launch anchored on a 12,627-hour, 40M-lb first-gen production record, not demos
reasoning.given: $5K/month pricing makes audited fleet operating-hours the unit buyers underwrite, pulling rivals on
reasoning.so_that: A general-purpose mobile-cobot vendor publishes a cross-customer fleet record above 100,000 production-operation hours
reasoning.landing: by H1 2027; one general-purpose mobile-cobot vendor, fleet-hours disclosure
reasoning.plain_language: Factory robots now brag about real hours worked, not demos; soon one will pass 100,000 hours across customers.

summary: Cobot's Gen-2 Proxie launch at Automate 2026 anchored on a first-gen operating record (12,627 hours, 40M+ pounds moved) and $5K/month pricing. Expect a general-purpose mobile-cobot vendor to publish a cross-customer fleet record above 100,000 production-operation hours by H1 2027.
